#DoDinKiZindagi, the second song from #GunmaasterG9, is OUT NOW!

Presented by @krishnamukut @sohamrockstrent Pvt Ltd

Directed by @aditya_datt
#GunmaasterG9 IN CINEMAS 27TH NOVEMBER 2026.
#DoDinKiZindagiOutNow #Gunmaaster
